payload.title: 7 Seminyak Wedding Venues for Beachside Vows
payload.excerpt: Seminyak sits on Bali's southwest coast, on the beach that stretches north from Kuta and Legian. The Seminyak wedding venues worth a shortlist split into two groups: five resorts that describe themselves as beachfront, and two addresses built around a pool rather than the sand.
key_takeaways: Five of the seven venues describe themselves as beachfront: W Bali Seminyak, The Oberoi, Bali, Alila Seminyak, The Seminyak Beach Resort & Spa and Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach.
Published wedding spaces run from a 16-guest hidden room at W Bali Seminyak to a deck that takes 300 for a reception, so match the space to your guest list before you fall for the view.
None of these seven venues publishes wedding pricing or exclusive use online, so ask each for a written quote that states whether your spaces can be closed to other guests.
Bali's wet season usually runs from around October to April, so every beach ceremony needs a covered fallback agreed before you sign.

faq.q: Can you get married on the beach in Seminyak?
faq.a: Yes. W Bali Seminyak, The Oberoi, Bali, Alila Seminyak, The Seminyak Beach Resort & Spa and Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach all describe themselves as beachfront and host weddings. The Seminyak Beach Resort's Purnama Chapel stands on Seminyak Beach itself.

faq.q: Which Seminyak venues offer exclusive use?
faq.a: None of the seven publishes exclusive use of the whole property. Hotel Indigo invites larger parties to ask about room blocks, and Mrs Sippy hosts private functions, so ask each venue in writing what private hire covers.

faq.q: How many guests can a Seminyak venue hold?
faq.a: From 16 in W Bali Seminyak's 1 BELOW to 300 for a reception on its WET Deck. In between, The Oberoi's garden takes 50, Hotel Indigo's venues take 80 each, and Purnama Chapel takes 90.

faq.q: Can Australians legally marry in Bali?
faq.a: Yes, if you meet Indonesia's requirements. Both parties must hold the same recognised religion, Australians need a Certificate of No Impediment, and non-Muslim marriages must be registered with the Civil Registry Office to be legal. Check the details with the Australian Embassy and Indonesian authorities, as at November 2026, before you book.

faq.q: Is Seminyak's wet season a problem for a beach wedding?
faq.a: It needs a plan rather than a different destination. The wet season usually runs from around October to April, and weather can change quickly, so agree an indoor or covered space with your venue before you sign.
